title: When the Colony Turns
author: Noor Villalobos
blurb: Freya Galloway, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
